reviews.text: Thank you!!!
Thank you for your review

Excellent for their welcome, quality organization, punctuality, and professionalism. I've been a customer for several years, and the standard of their services is always very high.
For me, boarding my cats, Stellina and Fiore, is always a pleasure. Cozy kennels surrounded by greenery in a peaceful environment.
The staff is kind and helpful.
The owners love animals and are always available.
Highly recommended.
We adopted our German Shepherd puppy here. The facility is excellent, and everyone is very friendly, always ready to help you raise our now-grown dog healthy and strong!
Beatrice, a truly wonderful girl, followed me! Thank you so much ❤️
Terrible. Incompetent workers. Since Franco hasn't worked, everything's been a mess!

I felt comfortable right away when I called looking for a male Maltipoo. I was greeted and cared for professionally, and they answered all my questions promptly. My 5-month-old puppy (now) is strong and beautiful, and everyone tells me he has a great build. I recommend this place for peace of mind when purchasing healthy, well-treated puppies, as there are many dangerous imports, especially for this type of dog. Maria Sara

The only kennel where I can safely leave my Morgan when I can't take him with me. I got both him and my first beloved PT Dexter from this kennel. I recommend it for the variety and quality of services it offers.
I went to see the place for a personal reason. Very well-maintained and clean, the owner was very kind and helpful. I liked it.
Thank you for your positive review

An excellent place to stay in Rome for pet owners.
It's been my go-to place for 28 years, and I wouldn't change them for the care they provide for our dogs.
Professional, kind, and helpful, they're also well-received by our "domestic friends" who happily spend long periods of time at their boarding kennels.
Excellent breeding.

I placed a pair of male and female cats, only five and a half years old, in a boarding facility for €35 a day. They were in excellent health.
After just seven days, the female died, despite being reassured daily that they were both fed according to my judgment, because the kennel was too exposed to the cold at night.
To find a home for the male, I was asked for more money, and despite finding a home more quickly than expected, I was not given anything back.
A disgrace.

I'm writing this review after months of ordeal, which began on August 22nd, when I was forced to interrupt my vacation to urgently pick up my cat from Casa Rita kennel. The incompetence of the staff who were supposed to care for him, combined with the neglect he was left in, led to a series of illnesses, the consequences of which we are still suffering. Several veterinary visits, invasive tests, and countless expensive therapies followed to treat the conditions I will now list, as per the veterinary reports: severe weight loss and dehydration, severe pain, stiff limbs, bedsores, an itchy fungal disease with alopecia covering two-thirds of his body, a purulent corneal ulcer in his right eye, bacterial cystitis with evident hematuria from E. coli at 10 to 6a, and then, according to Sabouraud, continuous jerking during sleep and a permanent dislocation of his left hind leg.
My cat is a splendid, long-lived Birman, and when she was brought home, Rita was in perfect health and weighed 4.9 kg (see Analysis and Veterinary Reports).
When the people at Casa Rita declared they no longer had any responsibility for the animal in their care, I felt it necessary to quickly remove her! I emphasize that interrupting my vacation resulted in a loss of thousands of euros, on top of the €700 requested for my cat's nightmarish stay!
This was the mistreatment meted out to long-time customers!!
I wish them the same suffering inflicted on my little animal.

We used this kennel as a boarding house both this summer and during our wedding, and I must say our dog had a wonderful time. We took her back. She was happy, active, and playful, and not at all fearful or mean; in fact, she was even more well-behaved. Thank you, Rita's family. Pat's owners.

Dear User,

We deeply regret this one-star rating. We take all feedback seriously and are committed to understanding what didn't meet your expectations.

Since you haven't left a comment, we invite you to contact us directly by email at info@casarita.it or by phone at +39 0666418642 so we can identify the issue and find a solution.

We hope this gives us the opportunity to improve your experience with us.

Best regards,
Riccardo Moscatelli

My friend and I took our pet to the German Shepherd Kennel_Casa Rita dal 1949, at Via di Brava 75. Since we took him back, he's been acting up constantly while sleeping or when I approach, as if he's afraid of something. He's never done that before! The vet said he was kept in stressful conditions. Furthermore, the owners are unfriendly, and it's expensive compared to other kennels. I highly recommend it.

I had to leave my cat behind for a long time due to family issues. I was very worried and found this boarding facility almost by chance. I was truly fortunate because the cat settled in perfectly right away.
Mr. Alessandro, the manager of the center, kept me updated on her condition.
She returned home a few days ago, serene, relaxed, and in perfect health. Thank you, Mr. Alessandro, for your kindness and great availability.
I truly recommend this boarding facility because it is run by attentive and competent people.
Thank you!

This summer, I accompanied a dear colleague of mine to urgently take her pet back to the Casa Rita German Shepherd Boarding and Kennel at Via di Brava 75. We then immediately went to the vet, who diagnosed him with severe dehydration. Given the large patches of hair loss, he deemed it necessary to have a hair exam, which later revealed he had contracted a fungal disease. This was due to his having been kept in unsanitary conditions during those days, as well as not being adequately fed and watered. Before that, he was an exceptional specimen! Furthermore, without on-site veterinary support, as they had promised, he did not receive any immediate treatment. I completely advise against this boarding facility.

This summer we took our cat to Casa Rita boarding kennels, and he was in excellent condition. When we picked him up, he was emaciated and dehydrated, with several health issues. We also noticed a corneal lesion in one eye, which the boarding kennel owners didn't detect, putting him at risk of losing his sight. To this day, the cat is still on an IV drip and hasn't recovered. I strongly advise against this facility.

A very dear friend of mine, during the August holidays, entrusted his pet to Casa Rita, a dog breeder and cattery. As soon as he got home, however, his pet was incredibly ill and vomited constantly! Was the food they gave him spoiled? Did he catch something from other animals? I'm sure he won't bring him here again.
Thank you!!
A guarantee of professionalism and availability in the uncertain world of dog breeding!
A thousand thanks
Good morning, Daniela. Please contact us to let us know what happened. Thank you.
I often bring my 2 dogs Diego and Attila and I get along well.

Never again! I left my two Pomeranians for 4 days and got them back in terrible conditions! Full of fleas and very dirty... they threw them into the gutter without any supervision. Terrible! Don't leave them if you love your dogs.
Thank you!
